item.title: Brain Tumor Talk Ep. 7: Breaking Down Biomarkers
item.description: Explore the role of biomarker and genetic testing in brain cancer care. This episode of Brain Tumor Talk breaks down how tumor profiling guides treatment for glioblastoma and beyond, empowering patients to make informed decisions.

item.title: 70-Year-Old Soccer Star Scores Big Against Glioblastoma with Ivy’s Innovative Treatment | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: Discover how Ann Rogers, a 70-year-old competitive soccer player, is thriving with glioblastoma. Explore groundbreaking treatments like Phase 0 clinical trials and liquid biopsy techniques at the Ivy Brain Tumor Center, giving hope to active brain cancer patients.

item.title: Brain Tumor Talk Ep. 8: A Young Couple Living Life with Brain Cancer
item.description: Discover DJ and Erin Stewart's inspiring glioblastoma journey. From diagnosis to advocacy, this Brain Tumor Talk episode highlights resilience, love, and how they’re making a difference in the brain tumor community.

item.title: Brain Tumor Talk Ep. 9: A Neurosurgical Legend | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: In this captivating episode of Brain Tumor Talk, we sit down with the legendary Dr. Robert F. Spetzler, whose groundbreaking career has left an indelible mark on medicine. From developing life-saving techniques like cardiac standstill and the Spetzler-Martin grading system to a childhood experience with tetanus that shaped his empathy as a physician, Dr. Spetzler shares the defining moments of his journey

item.title: Running—and the Ivy Brain Tumor Center at Barrow Neurological Institute—Saved Dad’s Life After Brain Tumor | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: In December 2018, Tim Soukup, a father of four, faced the unthinkable — a brain tumor diagnosis that led to awake brain surgery performed at Barrow Neurological Institute. Just one month after surgery, Tim completed a half marathon alongside his son, proving that nothing could him back. Fast-forward to January 2024, Tim accomplished a lifelong goal by qualifying for the Boston Marathon, finishing nearly 30 minutes faster than before his diagnosis.

item.title: Ivy Brain Tumor Center Hosts European investigator meeting for Gliofocus Study | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: Last month, leaders from the Ivy Brain Tumor Center traveled to Madrid, Spain, for the European Investigator Meeting for the Phase 3 Gliofocus Study. The meeting brought together 136 participants from 48 clinical trial sites across 13 countries to align on study goals, review protocols, and address challenges to ensure consistency and collaboration across all locations.

item.title: Father Beats Medulloblastoma, a Rare Brain Cancer in Adults | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: In less than two months, Joshua Zahn went from living as a healthy 31-year-old father and financial advisor to embarking on an arduous brain cancer journey. But thanks to the world-class care at Barrow Neurological Institute, combined with Joshua’s strong support system and own determination, he overcame his aggressive tumor and returned to his life.

item.title: Glioblastoma Awareness Day Making a Difference In 2025 | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: Learn about the impact of Glioblastoma Awareness Day and how the Ivy Brain Tumor Center is making a difference in the fight against brain cancer.

item.title: Park Ranger, Author Navigates Wild Terrain After Glioblastoma Diagnosis | Ivy Brain Tumor Center
item.description: In New Mexico, during the summer of 2023, Jeff Muse’s world changed. While serving as a park ranger and publishing his first book, he went from protecting public lands to uncharted territory when he was diagnosed with brain cancer. Jeff, 56, now in a clinical trial at the Ivy Brain Tumor Center, has found a way to navigate each day. He calls it “an equation for life.” Not a cure, not a solution, just a path—simple, hard-won, and very personal.
